title: 2.2.7d Lab — Method that returns a value
description: Add `Counter.isHigh()` which returns `true` when `this.n > 10`. The driver uses the return value to color the display red.

steps.title: Write the isHigh() method
steps.instructions: Inside the `Counter` class body, write an `isHigh()` method that returns `true` if `this.n` is greater than 10, and `false` otherwise. The driver already uses `c.isHigh()` to turn the number red — you supply the method.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer on the right — methods that return values use the `return` keyword just like regular functions.

requirements.title: isHigh() returns a comparison of this.n
requirements.description: Write `isHigh()` inside `Counter` — it must use `return` and compare `this.n > 10`.
